criteria.requirement: Add pluggy.scoped.temporary_plugins(manager,[(name,plugin),...]) context manager. Preflight all names/identities/blocked/existing conflicts before registration, preserve declared order and existing plugins, then remove only still-registered identical owned objects in reverse order on success/body error/partial historic registration failure. Respect manager-returned actual names via identity lookup, keep nested scopes independent and never remove an unrelated replacement subsequently installed under the same name. Reuse earlier identity repair for eq-equal/unhashable plugins. Roll back registrations/hooks/distribution associations via actual unregister semantics, not arbitrary external callback effects or all newly declared hookspecs.
